dict.string: MacFresh needs access to your Desktop to find junk and orphaned files.
MacFresh needs access to your Documents to find junk and orphaned files.
MacFresh needs access to your Downloads to find junk and orphaned files.
MacFresh needs access to removable volumes to scan for junk files.
MacFresh needs system administration access to clean caches and uninstall apps completely.

MacFresh reads the battery level of your connected keyboards, mice and headphones to show it in the menu bar panel.
MacFresh uses Apple Events to reveal files in Finder and to manage your login items through System Events.
